svg.title: Engineering organization — 60 engineers
svg.desc: Engineering organization: Principal Engineer leading 60 engineers, drawn as an org constellation of six clusters around one principal node. Delivery from GitHub: 1,755 pull requests (96% merged), 57,227 commits, 223 consecutive weeks shipping. Leadership pillars: Technical direction — Architecture vision, roadmaps and the standards 60 engineers build on. AI-first engineering culture — Every team pairs with agents: harnesses, skills and reviews built in-house. Quality at scale — Design reviews, code reviews and verification gates on every change. Mentorship — Growing senior engineers, plus 30+ bootcamp students mentored.
